manifest top-level keys == heroine hsc19 manifest
character is member-only liang-xu (no appearance key)
index has exactly the liang-xu key, no hero key, names the manifest
eight canonical actions: required with loop flags + skill
contract fields == heroine (cell, pivot, facing, scale, proportion)
cell and pivot even (logical scale 0.5)
every action duration == heroine (ticks)
tick schema: every action tick_rate 30, frames use ticks only, loop_start only on loops
strike cue (impact burst) on attack frame 0 = tick 0; no other attack frame has an impact
strike: folded board extended edge-first ahead of the body (tip >= pelvis + 30 px)
follow-through: board swings down after the strike (deg increases), then folds back up
guard opens the board into a two-panel shield held upright in front
skill = Tactical Calibration (board open, grid, ally signal, link ticks as the board folds)
defeat ends kneeling with eyes shut and the board down
sheet is a cell multiple, 6 columns, each cell == its pose PNG; package copy == outputs copy
